title: Spectroscopy of Blue #1 Dye in a Sports Drink
description: Chemistry Blue #1 Spectroscopy: prepare assigned 10 mL Blue #1 standards, measure and pool %T evidence, discover a teacher-confirmed calibration relationship, then design and justify an analysis of a blue sports drink containing only Blue #1.
learningGoals: Physically prepare the assigned 10 mL stock/water standards and calculate molarity with M1V1=M2V2.
Read percent transmittance at a teacher-set wavelength, record it separately, convert it to decimal T, and preserve class-row provenance.
Compare every source-listed transformation and use only the teacher-confirmed class calibration relationship.
Design, obtain approval for, execute, and justify a sports-drink Blue #1 analysis including dilution correction and mass in 500 mL.
safetyNotes: Treat food dye and sports drink as laboratory samples; do not consume them.
The source permits food dye and sports drink to be flushed with plenty of water, but the instructor must record any differing local cleanup or disposal rule.
Follow instructor-provided baseline PPE, instrument, cuvette, and cleanup directions.
